question: Did the joint rank-one optimizer fail to find an existing fixed invariant, or are the stable causal coordinates construction-conditioned or interaction-conditioned?

searched: temporal/iswas v15 DIM, complement, DAS, multi-environment, weight-interface, and construction-transfer records
projective bisector, pooled rank-one, Grassmann, and two-construction circuit records
canonical dossier, active claims, latest hourly and mathematical reviews
prior_art.known_lessons: The valid joint fit has no checkpoint feasible on both targets in both held parities, despite stable fold projectors and apparently good pooled v15 metrics. Local noise/Jacobian regularization did not solve the earlier construction failure.
prior_art.novelty: Separately identify each construction's rank-one causal axes under the same held-parity and control discipline, then execute the exact analytic projective minimax center without refitting.

frozen_design.fit: For each construction and training parity, initialize from that construction's head-response factor SVD, fit only that construction with eight Adam updates at .03, and select checkpoints 0/4/8 solely on the opposite parity using the .75 projection/.875 direction feasibility gate followed by worst P/C control score.
frozen_design.bisector: For each training parity and head, sign-align the separately selected A1/A2 unit axes and use their normalized sum. No gradient update, rank choice, or post-outcome orientation is allowed.
frozen_design.evaluation: Apply own, cross-construction, and bisector four-head tuples to opposite-parity v15 A1/A2/P/C. After all v15 fits and choices freeze, report v16 A1/A2/P for the same tuples. Complete attention-15 remains fixed to preserve comparability with the failed parent.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_parent_replay: All ancestry hashes, row alignments, manual/native and parent identity replay, gradient, orthogonality, bisector geometric identity, finiteness, and literal price checks pass.
predictions.pred_b_each_construction_has_a_stable_ef: Every A1-only and A2-only selected checkpoint is feasible on its held parity, and every head has within-construction fold cosine >= .75 for both constructions.
predictions.pred_c_construction_axes_are_distinct: At least one head has A1-versus-A2 absolute axis cosine < .75 in both training parities.
predictions.pred_d_cross_use_is_construction_specifi: For both A1 and A2, the own-oracle held-panel signed projection exceeds the cross-oracle projection by >= .08 in each evaluation parity.
predictions.pred_e_analytic_bisector_recovers_a_fixe: In each evaluation parity, the bisector reaches >= .75 signed projection and >= .875 direction fraction on both v15 A1/A2 with zero P/C flips; on v16 it reaches >= .65 and >= .875 on A1/A2 with zero P flips.
predictions.pred_f_bisector_beats_failed_joint_fit: The bisector's worst per-parity v15 target projection exceeds the corresponding failed joint selected checkpoint by >= .03 in both evaluation parities.

decision: If b/e/f pass, diagnose joint-optimizer failure and promote the bisector to the pending attention-15 dependency factorial. If b/c/d pass while e fails, select a construction-routed finite mixture. If b fails, reject stable rank one. If per-head geometric overlap is high but e fails, test ordered cross-head interactions before adding rank.
